## Houston 0.6.22

### Updates that finish what they start

- **A large update keeps going after your connection drops**, resuming where it stopped instead of starting over.
- **Houston checks for a new version once when it opens**, so startup is quicker and quieter.

### Skills and connected apps behave

- **Finding and installing a skill is more dependable**, with searches that end on their own and skills that no longer exist kept out of the list.
- **Disconnecting an app while it is still connecting no longer looks like a failure**, the row simply goes back to available.

### Fixes and polish

- **Houston opens reliably on Windows.**
- **Your saved routines keep loading**, even when an odd character slips into them.
- **A model key that gets rejected explains what to fix**, in plain words.
- **Dictation tells you what went wrong** when it stops unexpectedly.
- **Your usage limit clears as soon as it resets.**
- **A mission you just started appears on your board** while the agent wakes up.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.
